originalTitle: Indian bonds buckle under oil spike, fresh debt sale
simplifiedContent: The Indian government's bonds, which are like loans to the government, decreased in value on Friday. This happened because oil prices increased and investors are worried about interest rates going up. The Indian government is planning to sell more bonds today to raise 320 billion rupees, which may have also affected investor confidence. The recent increase in oil prices is a big factor in this change. The central bank of India kept its key interest rate the same, which helps with inflation, but it didn't stop the bonds from decreasing in value.

originalTitle: US Stock Market: SpaceX shares gain as first lockup expiry more than doubles tradable float
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening with SpaceX's stock: the company's shares went up by over 6% on Thursday, with a lot of people buying and selling. This happened even though a big group of shareholders were allowed to sell their shares for the first time, which usually can cause the stock price to go down. However, the opposite happened, and the stock price rose. This is a big deal because it means that many more shares are now available for the public to buy and sell, over 911 million more to be exact, in addition to the shares that were already being traded. This increased the total number of shares that can be bought and sold, which can affect the stock's price and overall activity.

originalTitle: Global Market: Japan stocks fall over 1% as chip shares tumble, SoftBank declines despite earnings beat
simplifiedContent: The Japanese stock market, also known as the Nikkei, fell by over 1% on Friday. This happened because some technology companies, especially those that make computer chips, had a bad day and their stock prices went down. SoftBank Group, a big company, also had a bad day, with its stock price falling 4.3% even though it made a profit, just not as much as expected. This matters because it shows that investors are cautious and not easily impressed by good news. The fall in the Nikkei index means that the overall value of the stocks in the Japanese market decreased, which can affect investors who have money in those stocks.

originalTitle: Small-cap stock close to life-time high after Q1 results 2026, jumps 3% in opening bell
simplifiedContent: Here's a simple explanation of the news: The stock price of Standard Engineering, a small company, went up by 3% when the stock market opened. This happened after the company shared its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The stock price reached a high point of ₹288.35, which is very close to its all-time highest price. This is a significant increase, indicating that investors are positive about the company's performance. The jump in stock price suggests that investors are optimistic about the company's future after seeing its latest financial results.

originalTitle: 778% rally in five years! Multibagger pharma stock close to record high after Q1 results 2026
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: Fredun Pharmaceuticals' stock price went up by 3.5% after the company released its quarterly results, which showed a big increase in profit and revenue. The company's profit increased by 94.1% compared to the same time last year, and its revenue also went up by 90.7%. This means the company is making more money, which is good news for investors. The stock price has risen a lot over the past five years, by 778%, and is now close to its all-time high. This increase in stock price is likely due to the company's strong financial performance, which makes it an attractive investment opportunity.

originalTitle: Behari Lal Engineering IPO: Price band set at  ₹271-285 per share; check key dates, issue details
simplifiedContent: A company called Behari Lal Engineering Limited is going to sell its shares to the public for the first time, which is called an Initial Public Offering (IPO). The company has decided that the price of each share will be between ₹271 and ₹285. People can buy these shares from August 12 to August 14, and the company will give out the shares by August 17. The shares will then be available for trading on the stock market on August 19. This matters because it gives people a chance to invest in the company and potentially make money if the company does well.
